assumptions.servo_source: Seats from the official Feetech FS90MG drawing p.5 (datasheets/FS90MG.pdf). Lighter Tomo uses the plastic-gear FS90, whose Feetech spec sheet gives the same 22.5 × 12.1 × 22.4 case (9 g, 1.3 kg·cm at 4.8 V, 21T spline): https://www.feetech.cn/en/6v-15kg-9g-dc-reduction-steering-gear-tooth-box
assumptions.horn: ASSUMED typical 2.0 mm disc + 4-arm star, Ø24. Not on the drawing. p.6 says No Accessories.
assumptions.spline_teeth: FS90 spec sheet: 21T (Ø4.86). Use the horns that come with the servo; measure on arrival.
assumptions.arm_servos: None. Arms are passive: vertical shoulder hinge + torsion spring (3HPG6 LH / 3HPD1 RH, 3.36 N·mm/°, 50° preload), printed stops at 0° and 30°.
assumptions.head_servos: 2× Feetech FS90 (was FS90MG): pan in the yaw collar, tilt on the neck turret (spline on the tilt axis).
assumptions.speaker: Adafruit 3923 Mini Oval 8Ω 1W, 30×20×5, 3 g, Core ADA3923 A$4.80
assumptions.fastener_scheme: M2.5 clearance 2.8 / pilot 2.1 (front=clearance, back=pilot). Servo self-tap pilots 1.7. Retainer M2 clearance 2.3 / pilot 1.7.
assumptions.running_fit: Journal radial and blade side 0.35 mm (tight end of 0.35–0.4 FDM). Axial washer gap 0.30 mm. Retainer play 0.35 mm.

Clearances by tilt: {'t-12': {'head_to_turret': 0.6, 'head_to_collar': 6.24, 'camera_to_tilt_servo': 34.92, 'head_to_tilt_servo': 1.5}, 't-6': {'head_to_turret': 0.6, 'head_to_collar': 6.89, 'camera_to_tilt_servo': 35.16, 'head_to_tilt_servo': 1.5}, 't0': {'head_to_turret': 0.6, 'head_to_collar': 7.0, 'camera_to_tilt_servo': 34.83, 'head_to_tilt_servo': 1.5}, 't6': {'head_to_turret': 0.6, 'head_to_collar': 5.63, 'camera_to_tilt_servo': 33.95, 'head_to_tilt_servo': 1.5}, 't12': {'head_to_turret': 0.6, 'head_to_collar': 1.7, 'camera_to_tilt_servo': 33.15, 'head_to_tilt_servo': 1.5}}. The face is a cap of the one-piece egg, split from the body by a seam sphere centred on the tilt-axis line (meets the skin at z≈101, 3 mm gap), so the cap pans and tilts inside the egg with a matching skin. Lower seam bosses x ±32, z 106; upper x ±27, z 136.
rows.fix: Margin to the first contact: 3.5° nodding down, 13.5° looking up, beyond the ±10° firmware clamp. Fur in the seam gap is compliant.

rows.interface: Neck cable path (pan + tilt servo leads, camera FPC)
rows.measured: Pan servo lead: fixed in the collar, never crosses a moving joint. Tilt servo lead: rides on the turret, so it crosses the PAN joint only; route it down the Ø34 collar bore beside the FPC with a loose service loop (≥40 mm) for ±42°. Camera FPC crosses pan and tilt: turret deck slot (x 5.5–22.5) → r=14 U-bend loop bay in the head, which sits close to the tilt axis (±10° ≈ ±3 mm of FPC travel). Turret deck slot probe width 2.5 mm (design 2.5).
rows.fix: Do not twist the FPC around the yaw axis; let it roll in the U-bend. Tie the tilt lead to the FPC so they move together.

rows.interface: Arm swing (passive, vertical shoulder hinges, 0–30°)
rows.measured: Arms turn about vertical shoulder pins (knuckle z 70–86, just under the face seam); 0° = hugging on the rest stop, 30° = open stop. Asymmetric Mirumi-style arms: the left runs over the chest and ends low on the far side, the right drops down its flank and sweeps under the belly. Min clearances by angle {'a0': {'arm_L_to_torso_front': -0.0, 'pad_L_to_torso_front': 1.7, 'arm_R_to_torso_front': -0.0, 'pad_R_to_torso_front': 1.08, 'arm_L_to_arm_R_both_at_angle': 4.96}, 'a10': {'arm_L_to_torso_front': 0.4, 'pad_L_to_torso_front': 9.59, 'arm_R_to_torso_front': 0.4, 'pad_R_to_torso_front': 9.38, 'arm_L_to_arm_R_both_at_angle': 10.02}, 'a20': {'arm_L_to_torso_front': 0.4, 'pad_L_to_torso_front': 16.67, 'arm_R_to_torso_front': 0.4, 'pad_R_to_torso_front': 16.68, 'arm_L_to_arm_R_both_at_angle': 9.86}, 'a30': {'arm_L_to_torso_front': -0.0, 'pad_L_to_torso_front': 23.57, 'arm_R_to_torso_front': 0.0, 'pad_R_to_torso_front': 23.98, 'arm_L_to_arm_R_both_at_angle': 7.51}}; worst {'arm_to_shell': -0.0, 'pad_to_shell': 1.08, 'arm_to_arm': 4.96, 'arm_L_closed_vs_arm_R_open': 11.12, 'arm_L_open_vs_arm_R_closed': 27.19, 'arm_lowest_z_mm': 18.05, 'note': 'arm_to_shell 0 = the stop lug resting on its relief face (by design); knuckle to ear is 0.4 mm', 'ok': True} (arm_to_shell ≈ 0.4 = knuckle under the ear). Every arm point moves outward as it opens (all band points lie on the front side of their own hinge).
rows.fix: Passive: a child can push the arms open by hand; nothing is driven, so there is no gear train to strip. The pads are a deliberate soft pinch point (~2–3 N).

rows.interface: Passive hug grip (round Ø10 / 12.5 / 15 lying diagonally in the groove, flat 25 mm strap)
rows.parts: arm_L/R, paw_pad_L/R, torso_front (groove), grip test objects
rows.measured: round Ø10.0 lying diagonally in the groove (35° from vertical): L opens 3.8°, pad 3.52 N (lever 51.4 mm, spring 180.9 N·mm, contact z 61.2), rigid arm 1.43 mm clear; R opens 3.54°, pad 3.25 N (lever 55.5 mm, spring 180.1 N·mm, contact z 24.0), rigid arm 1.46 mm clear; total 6.76 N, into the groove 6.62 N; round Ø12.5 lying diagonally in the groove (35° from vertical): L opens 6.54°, pad 3.66 N (lever 51.9 mm, spring 190.2 N·mm, contact z 60.7), rigid arm 1.42 mm clear; R opens 6.08°, pad 3.37 N (lever 56.0 mm, spring 188.6 N·mm, contact z 24.0), rigid arm 1.44 mm clear; total 7.03 N, into the groove 6.97 N; round Ø15.0 lying diagonally in the groove (35° from vertical): L opens 9.25°, pad 3.74 N (lever 53.4 mm, spring 199.3 N·mm, contact z 60.5), rigid arm 1.43 mm clear; R opens 8.63°, pad 3.53 N (lever 55.9 mm, spring 197.2 N·mm, contact z 24.1), rigid arm 1.43 mm clear; total 7.26 N, into the groove 7.24 N; flat strap 25 x 2.5 across the groove mouth, along the groove line: L opens 5.86°, pad 3.23 N (lever 58.1 mm, spring 187.9 N·mm, contact z 57.6), rigid arm 1.43 mm clear; R opens 6.19°, pad 2.83 N (lever 66.7 mm, spring 189.0 N·mm, contact z 27.7), rigid arm 1.42 mm clear; total 6.07 N, into the groove 6.07 N. Spring: music-wire torsion spring, 0.048 in (1.22 mm) wire, 3/8 in (9.5 mm) OD, 90° legs (trim to ~6 mm); catalogue 3HPG6 (LH) / 3HPD1 (RH), 3.363 N·mm/°, preload 50.0°. Assumption: Spring rate from the catalogue (2.679 lbf·in at 90°), linear; no hinge friction; each arm clamps on its own (left over the chest at C_L, right under the belly at C_R); pad normal force = spring torque / |(r x n)_z| at the deepest pad contact. TPU pads assumed rigid for the angle (real pads add ~1 mm of squash). Not measured.
rows.fix: Forces are from the catalogue spring rate, not measured. Each arm clamps the handle on its own crossing; the TPU pads take the squash.
